title: World peace, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Hope for a world where peace becomes a reality Collectible work filled with universal values Symbol of harmony and cooperation among nations Inspiration to build a better future Peace is the highest value that unites people beyond all divisions. The symbol of a dove with an olive branch reminds us of harmony and hope — the foundations of a better tomorrow. This extraordinary coin, adorned with Polish amber, inspires reflection on global unity and the beauty of peace.
